model_policy: All independent evaluation agents inherited the parent model and reasoning effort; no model overrides were used.
execution: Independent Codex collaboration sessions; 24 cases batched per condition; final run additionally included 2 followup cases.
baseline_instruction: Read only the input requests. Fulfill each as a capable editor preserving scientific meaning. Return id, revised, reasons, queries. Do not read skill, criteria, examples, memory or other outputs; no browsing.
skill_instruction: Read SKILL.md and necessary linked editing references. Apply bibang to each independent request. Return id, revised, reasons, queries. Do not read criteria, examples, memory, sources.md or other outputs; no browsing.
iteration: Initial F04 missed implementation-status ambiguity. Added one cross-sentence check to scientific-fidelity.md, then ran all 24 cases and 2 followups in a fresh agent.
limitations: One batch per condition, not independently randomized cases
Developer-authored cases and non-blinded developer review
Exact API model and sampling settings unavailable
Not a Codex CLI or Claude Code model benchmark
post_text_evaluation_change: Added file-write-denial fallback after CLI permission failure. Text editing rules unchanged. File behavior tested separately.
